project.name: MagicBox Modernization
project.objective: The objective is to modernize the codebase by implementing helper code refusal propagation and addressing H11, ensuring robust error handling and observability.

recommended_strategy.rationale: Allows gradual transition to new technologies while maintaining existing functionality.

phases.outcome: Migrate forms/modules with dependency risk controls.

blocking.question: Target application architecture for the modernization
blocking.default_recommendation: Start with a modular monolith unless there is a clear reason to decompose immediately.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Early coupling / drift that is expensive to correct downstream.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.

blocking.question: Authentication / authorization strategy for the modern target
blocking.default_recommendation: Model current auth behavior first, then move to a clearer standards-based target with explicit compatibility rules.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Authorization regressions and lost session context during cutover.

blocking.question: Confirm identity/access model (role model, multi-user assumptions, and credential handling).
blocking.default_recommendation: Define target role model and credential policy before implementation.

blocking.question: Are there existing operational constraints or integration dependencies not listed?
blocking.default_recommendation: Resolve with product/business owner before implementation commitment.

blocking.question: What are target latency, throughput, and availability SLOs?
blocking.default_recommendation: Resolve with product/business owner before implementation commitment.

blocking.question: Ground BDD acceptance criteria in real legacy golden flows before Build planning.
blocking.default_recommendation: Regenerate BDD from validated golden flows, route evidence, and SQL touchpoints before Build starts.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Acceptance criteria will not validate real legacy behavior, creating parity and release risk.

non_blocking.question: Logging and observability stack for migrated runtime
non_blocking.default_recommendation: OpenTelemetry + structured logs for parity troubleshooting.

top_risks.description: Potential performance degradation due to new monitoring tools.
top_risks.mitigation: Conduct performance testing to ensure minimal impact.

top_risks.description: Security risks from logging sensitive error data.
top_risks.mitigation: Implement encryption and access controls for error logs.

Implement golden-flow harness for parity validation

in_scope: Preserve legacy business behavior and workflows
Migrate UI and code to target stack
Control dependency and data-side risks during migration

musts: No critical workflow regression for P0 flows
Traceability from requirements to tests and evidence artifacts
shoulds: Preserve DB contracts unless explicitly approved to change

items.title: Implement Structured Error Handling
items.outcome: Develop a consistent error handling framework across the application.
acceptance_criteria: All modules must log errors using a centralized logging system.
Error messages must be user-friendly and actionable.
System must support configurable error notification settings.

items.title: Enhance Observability
items.outcome: Integrate observability tools to monitor application performance and errors.
acceptance_criteria: System must provide real-time monitoring dashboards.
Alerts must be configurable based on error thresholds.
Historical data must be retained for at least 30 days.

items.title: Backward Compatibility Assurance
items.outcome: Ensure that new changes do not break existing functionality.
acceptance_criteria: All existing tests must pass with new changes.
New features must be toggleable to revert if needed.
User acceptance testing must confirm no regressions.

items.title: Refusal Propagation Mechanism
items.outcome: Implement a mechanism to propagate refusal of helper code execution.
acceptance_criteria: Refusal reasons must be logged with context.
System must notify relevant stakeholders upon refusal.
Refusal propagation must not impact system performance.

items.title: Automated Testing for Error Scenarios
items.outcome: Develop automated tests to cover new error handling scenarios.
acceptance_criteria: Tests must cover all critical error paths.
Tests must simulate real-world error conditions.
Test results must be integrated into CI/CD pipeline.

items.title: User Feedback on Errors
items.outcome: Collect user feedback on error messages to improve clarity.
acceptance_criteria: User feedback must be collected via a survey mechanism.
Feedback must be analyzed monthly for trends.
Error messages must be updated based on feedback.

items.title: Integration with External Monitoring Services
items.outcome: Integrate with external services for enhanced monitoring capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Integration must support at least two external services.
Data must be securely transmitted to external services.
External monitoring must not degrade system performance.

items.title: Performance Impact of Observability
items.outcome: Ensure observability tools do not degrade system performance.
acceptance_criteria: System response time must remain within acceptable limits.
Performance tests must show less than 5% degradation.
Monitoring overhead must be documented and reviewed.

items.title: Security of Error Data
items.outcome: Ensure error data is securely stored and transmitted.
acceptance_criteria: Error logs must be encrypted using AES-256.
Access to logs must be restricted to authorized personnel.
Security audits must be conducted quarterly.

items.title: Scalability of Monitoring Solutions
items.outcome: Ensure monitoring solutions can scale with increased load.
acceptance_criteria: Monitoring must remain stable under increased load.
Scalability tests must simulate double the current load.
No data loss must occur during peak loads.

items.title: Usability of Error Messages
items.outcome: Ensure error messages are clear and actionable for users.
acceptance_criteria: Error messages must be tested with user groups.
Feedback must indicate high clarity and usefulness.
Documentation must support error message understanding.

items.title: Define identity and access model for modernization scope
items.outcome: Confirm role model, credential policy, and multi-user assumptions before implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Remediation implemented and validated against affected legacy flow.
Evidence artifacts updated with before/after traceability.
